chunks: Muhammad ibn Umar al-Hafith al-Baghdadi narrated to us. He said: Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Thabit ibn Kinana narrated to me. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Abbas Abu Ja'far al-Khuza'i narrated to us. He said: Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Urni narrated to us. He said: Amr ibn Thabit narrated to us, from Ata' ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abu Yahya, from Ibn Abbas, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) climbed the pulpit and gave a sermon, and the people gathered around him. He said: O assembly of the believers! Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has revealed to me that I will die, and my cousin Ali will be killed. O people! I inform you of a matter: if you act by it, you will be safe, and if you abandon it, you will be destroyed.
Indeed, my cousin Ali is my brother and my vizier. He is my vicegerent. He is the one who speaks on my behalf. He is the Imam of the pious, the Leader of the radiant and distinguished believers.

If you seek his guidance, he will guide you. If you follow him, you will be delivered. If you oppose him, you will go astray. If you obey him, you will have obeyed Allah. If you disobey him, you will have disobeyed Allah. If you pledge allegiance to him, you will have pledged allegiance to Allah. And if you renege on your allegiance to him, then you will have reneged on your allegiance to Allah.
Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed the Quran to me; and he [Ali] is the one who, whoever disobeys him, goes astray. Whoever seeks his knowledge from other than Ali will be destroyed.

O people! Hear my words and recognize the truth of my advice. Do not do anything after me regarding my Ahl al-Bayt except that which you have been ordered to do regarding their protection, for they are my kin, my relatives, my brothers, and my children. You will be gathered and questioned about the Two Weighty Things, so look to how you treat them after me.

They are my Ahl al-Bayt: whoever harms them has harmed me, whoever oppresses them has oppressed me, whoever belittles them has belittled me, whoever cherishes them has cherished me, whoever honours them has honoured me, whoever supports them has supported me, whoever lets them down has let me down. Whoever seeks guidance in other than them has belied me.

O people! Fear Allah and look to what you will say when you meet Him, for I am the adversary of whoever harms them, and whoever I am the adversary of, I will defeat. I say this saying of mine, and I seek forgiveness of Allah for me and for you.

key_terms.الثقلين: The Two Weighty Things — referring to the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.الغر المحجلين: The shining/radiant believers — a prophetic epithet for the followers of truth
key_terms.خليفتي: My vicegerent/successor — indicates political and spiritual succession

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali and the Ahl al-Bayt in his sermon?
ai.summary: In this sermon from the pulpit, the Prophet Muhammad (s) announced Ali's appointment as his brother, vicegerent, and the Imam of the pious, equating obedience to Ali with obedience to Allah. He further commanded the community to protect his Ahl al-Bayt, warning that they would be questioned about the Two Weighty Things (the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt) on the Day of Judgment.
word_analysis: you treat me (after I am gone)
